free-to-play.text: The sawmill operator pays you no attention, it doesn't seem like he'll help you.

standard-dialogue.npc: Hello there. Do you want me to make some planks for you? I can make planks from wood, oak, teak and mahogany logs. Or would you like to buy some other housing supplies?

options.text: Yes, please make me some planks.

steps.player: Yes, please make me some planks.

steps.text: If the player does not have the chosen log in their inventory:

steps.npc: You'll need to bring me some more logs.

steps.text: If the player does not have enough coins:

steps.npc: Those planks cost [X] coins. You don't have enough money for all of them.

options.text: Can I buy some housing supplies?

steps.player: Can I buy some housing supplies?

steps.npc: Well come back when you want some. You'll struggle to find quality planks anywhere but here!
